rationale: Recommend no. The held Federal Register text of EO 9616 (10 FR 11837, signed September 14, 1945) repeals Executive Order No. 9245 of September 16, 1942 in its paragraph 1 and transfers the functions, personnel, records, property and funds back to the High Commissioner, with no deferred effect; the OFR catalog note agrees. No earlier end or surviving command was found, so the order was not in force on 2026-10-14.
